title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the X-Y plane, and within this sketch, draw a single loop consisting of one circle. Center the circle at coordinates [0.023, 0.023] and set the radius to 0.023. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0461 to adjust the size. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.04606228346456693 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.023, 0.023).circle(0.023)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.023, 0.023)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.023)         # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
